Message: YAML alias '*Retention' is rejected by CloudFormation unless the template is first processed by the 'package' cli command or AWS SAM

Rule.Description: The CloudFormation service does not support YAML anchors or aliases. Templates that use them can only be deployed through the AWS CLI 'package' command or AWS SAM, which resolve the aliases client-side before sending the template to CloudFormation.
Rule.ShortDescription: Validate if the template is using YAML aliases
